title: Extended-Distance Mileage Charge Calculation for Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
The extended-distance charge on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment is every road mile beyond the service level's included radius, each mile charged in full at the service level's per-mile fee. The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## The quantities

1. **Road miles beyond the included radius** — the road miles from the delivering club recorded on the appointment, less the included radius of the appointment's service level, never fewer than zero.
2. **Per-mile fee** — the service level's fee per road mile beyond the included radius, as the service level's mileage figures state it.
3. **Charge** — the road miles beyond the included radius multiplied by the per-mile fee, rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Road miles recorded on the appointment | 73 |
| Included radius of the service level | 50 |
| Per-mile fee of the service level | $1.40 |

Miles beyond the radius: 73 less 50, 23 miles. Charge: 23 miles multiplied by $1.40, $32.20.

A second hypothetical: 57 road miles, a 50-mile radius and a $1.15 per-mile fee give 7 miles multiplied by $1.15, $8.05.

An appointment whose road miles are not more than the radius has no miles beyond it and no charge.
